# Lint — required_fields checker: pages that leave a schema-required field unset

# ============================================================
# Section 1: a page write validation refuses is still swept
# ============================================================

exec akb init required-fields-kb
cd required-fields-kb

# init seeds no templates: copy the one this scenario writes pages of.
exec akb template get adr --full --examples
cp stdout .agent-kb/templates/adr.yaml
exec git add .agent-kb/templates
exec git commit -m 'seed adr template'

# An ADR leaving out the schema-required status and deciders fields. akb write
# refuses it, so it is copied in directly: this is the pre-existing page the
# sweep has to reach.
exec mkdir -p kb/decisions
exec cp ../incomplete-adr.md kb/decisions/incomplete-adr.md

# The required_fields issue is an error, so the sweep fails.
! exec akb lint

# Exactly one required_fields issue, reported against the incomplete ADR and
# worded the way the write path refuses the same page.
stdout -count=1 'rule_id=required_fields'
stdout '(?s)=== kb/decisions/incomplete-adr\.md ===\n(  \[[^\n]*\n)*  \[required_fields\] rule_id=required_fields error: missing required frontmatter field\(s\): deciders, status \(declared required by template "adr"\)'

# It is the only error-severity issue of the run: the other issues the page
# collects (index_consistency, orphans) are warnings.
stdout -count=1 'error:'

! exec akb lint --json
stdout '"required_fields": 1'

# ============================================================
# Section 2: no false positives for pages whose schema another check owns
# ============================================================

cd ..
exec akb init other-checks-own-the-schema-kb
cd other-checks-own-the-schema-kb

# init seeds no templates: copy the one this scenario writes pages of.
exec akb template get note --full --examples
cp stdout .agent-kb/templates/note.yaml
exec git add .agent-kb/templates
exec git commit -m 'seed note template'

# A page whose type has no template and a page without frontmatter declare no
# schema: type_orphan and missing_frontmatter report them, not this check.
exec sh -c 'echo "A page with no frontmatter at all." > kb/bare.md'
exec mkdir -p kb/notes
exec cp ../retired-type.md kb/notes/retired-type.md

# A well-formed page of a type whose schema it satisfies.
stdin ../good-note.md
exec akb write good-note.md
stdout 'Written to kb/notes/good-note.md'
exec akb index add kb/notes/good-note.md 'A well-formed note'

! exec akb lint
! stdout 'required_fields'

! exec akb lint --json
stdout '"required_fields": 0'

-- incomplete-adr.md --
---
type: adr
title: Incomplete ADR
summary: An ADR that never passed write validation
tags: linttest
created: '2026-01-01'
updated: '2026-09-01'
---
Decision body without the required status and deciders fields.

-- retired-type.md --
---
type: retired-type
title: Retired Type Page
---
Body of a page whose type has no template.

-- good-note.md --
---
type: note
title: Good Note
summary: A well-formed note for testing
tags: linttest
created: '2026-01-01'
updated: '2026-09-01'
---
This is a well-formed note with proper frontmatter.
